brand.name: Vibe Engineering
brand.category: AI-era systems thinking and creative decision-making
brand.origin_story: Vibe Engineering grew from a simple problem: AI can make almost anything quickly, but speed without judgment creates sameness, weak decisions, and false confidence. VIBE turns the human part into a repeatable practice: understand the idea, see the system, use taste, verify the work, and keep ownership.

strategy.positioning_statement: For non-technical creators, young builders, founders, operators, and small-business owners, Vibe Engineering is the AI-era thinking and making system that helps them turn ideas into real things with systems thinking, taste, proof, and ownership because it makes the human decision process explicit instead of asking people to trust a one-shot AI output.
strategy.brand_promise: A better way to turn your ideas into real things without giving up your judgment or control.
proof_points: V.I.B.E. makes verification the first principle: Verify It Before Everything.
The method separates idea, system, build, proof, judgment, and ownership instead of treating generation as completion.
The public experience is designed for people who do not identify as developers.
The product repo includes explicit verification, quality, ownership, and rollback doctrine rather than generation-only workflows.

differentiation.everybody_zigs: Lead with faster generation, more tools, more agents, technical power, or one-shot outputs.
differentiation.we_zag: Lead with the human operating system: know what you want, see how the pieces connect, use your taste, make a decision, verify the result, and own it.

primary.description: Non-technical creators and builders—especially younger people, founders, operators, and small-business owners—who have ideas and access to AI but need a simple process for turning output into intentional, useful work.
psychographics: Values culture and taste but dislikes fake trend-chasing
Learns better through examples and action than lectures
Needs a clear process that reduces cognitive load

tribes: Young people learning to direct AI

tone_rules.do: Lead with one concrete idea and short sentences. Make the next action obvious.
tone_rules.dont: Explain internal architecture, model routing, or methodology jargon before the visitor understands the point.

tone_rules.do: Show the decision through a real example: compare, choose, test, verify.
tone_rules.dont: Lecture people with abstract systems language when the same lesson can be demonstrated.

tone_rules.do: Sound current through confidence, observation, and specificity.
tone_rules.dont: Use forced slang, fake street language, or decorative 'urban' clichés.

tone_rules.do: Name the problem plainly and show the better decision.
tone_rules.dont: Mock the user, shame beginners, or make AI itself the villain.

display.rationale: Architectural structure with human warmth. It communicates systems thinking without looking like default SaaS typography and gives large statements a recognizable shape without relying on graffiti or distressed display tropes.

body.rationale: A clean, precise neo-grotesk keeps teaching copy, navigation, captions, and interfaces readable while letting the content and imagery carry culture.

protected_items: V.I.B.E. means Verify It Before Everything.
Vibe Engineering is part of the Pauli suite of products.
The audience does not need to become developers.
Human judgment, taste, systems thinking, proof, and ownership remain central.
